Chapter 1157 - 21: My Name Is ’Galaxy’ (Requesting Monthly Tickets At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1157: Chapter 21: My Name is ’Galaxy’ (Requesting Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)

The vast expanse of space-time forcibly replaced the Xuanhuang Universe, enveloping the nine Chaos Great Saints like insects in amber, enduring immense pressure every moment.

The many rules and great paths operating in the Xuanhuang Universe retreated and avoided, that eternal Fierce Sun spanning the center of space-time, wherever its sunlight shone, it became a domain.

"The rules and great paths of this Postnatal Universe are far more oppressive than the rules and great paths of the outside Chaos Void. Now the rules and great paths within the universe retreat and avoid, surely the same would happen in the Chaos Void..."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint steadied himself, incredulous: "Is this the fruition of an unrivaled Great Saint’s thought to control the void? The space-time rules around the standing position are all set by oneself?"

"No, it’s merely the great path rules retreating and avoiding, it hasn’t reached the level of setting one’s own rules, it’s not an unrivaled Great Saint..."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint swallowed hard.

At this moment, the strength Lin Yuan displayed, even if not an unrivaled Great Saint, far surpassed them.

At least the Wild Barbarian Great Saint considered himself not a match, not even necessary to confront.

"How is he so powerful?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint was equally shocked. Previously, outside the Xuanhuang Universe, he had used a killing move to hold Lin Yuan momentarily, so he was the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

At that time, Lin Yuan indeed put some pressure on the Dual Origin Great Saint.

But it was only the pressure facing an enemy of the same tier.

And now? Is this an enemy of the same tier?

"If you wish to survive..."

Lin Yuan stood there, overlooking each Chaos Great Saint, speaking calmly: "Then swear to immediately exit this universe, not approaching for a thousand Cosmic Eras."

Except for the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, Lin Yuan had no significant grudges with the other Chaos Great Saints, as long as they didn’t continue to stay in the Xuanhuang Universe, Lin Yuan didn’t mind letting them go this once.

The main issue was the impossibility of eradicating all roots, these Chaos Great Saints had many life-saving measures, even if they died within this universe, they would resurrect in other hidden places.

They might not even need resurrection.

"Immediately exit this universe?"

The Black Light Great Saint, with his Black Light Domain, could only maintain it within ten thousand miles, looked at Lin Yuan with a grim face: "Not just exiting this palace, but directly exiting this universe?"

With Lin Yuan’s current explosive strength, the Black Light Great Saint no longer planned to resist forcefully, if possible, he would take that dark palace and look for treasures in other regions.

This universe, since it could nurture a supreme treasure at the level of an unrivaled Great Saint, could produce a second or third one.

Even if unable to acquire a treasure at the unrivaled Great Saint level, at least obtaining one at the Chaos Great Saint level would justify the trip.

To get close to this universe as quickly as possible, the Black Light Great Saint had already paid a hefty price.

"Isn’t your appetite too large, not being an unrivaled Great Saint, yet wanting to do the deeds of an unrivaled Great Saint?" The Dual Origin Great Saint also stared at Lin Yuan.

The space-time formed around Lin Yuan indeed exerted immense pressure, far surpassing the Black Light Domain.

If it were only the Dual Origin Great Saint alone, he wouldn’t speak this way, because he indeed had no means to resist the surrounding space-time suppression.

But now, besides the Dual Origin Great Saint, there were other eight Chaos Great Saints, two of whom were formidable Great Saints.

If the nine Chaos Great Saints joined forces, even if unable to defeat Lin Yuan, at least they could contend with him.

At worst, even if they lost in the end, the Dual Origin Great Saint was confident in his escape.

No matter how strong Lin Yuan was, he was not an unrivaled Great Saint.

"Indeed."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint glanced at the Dual Origin Great Saint and the Black Light Great Saint, also staring at Lin Yuan: "This dark palace can be given to you, but asking us to exit immediately is somewhat excessive."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint had been starkly gouged by the Eye of Myriad Laws, feeling the pain even now, unwilling to give up.

Tian Lu Great Saint, Nine Phoenix Great Saint, and other ordinary Great Saints hesitated slightly, unlike the Dual Origin Great Saint and Wild Barbarian Great Saint, they truly felt the risk of falling under the suppression of the surrounding space-time.

The three formidable Great Saints could say so because they had confidence in saving themselves, but what about the six of them?

Although falling now doesn’t mean total death, the cost of using life-saving means to retrain to peak strength is significant.

"Only by joining forces can we protect ourselves." The Dual Origin Great Saint immediately transmitted to the six Chaos Great Saints.

Although the strength of these six Chaos Great Saints wasn’t equal to them, during a real fight, these six could at least divert some of Lin Yuan’s attention.

Thus, the pressure on the three formidable Great Saints would be somewhat alleviated.

"If we retreat, it’s equivalent to giving up on this universe. I can share some intel, the creator of this universe is an unrivaled Great Saint close to invincible in strength, astonishingly strong."

"The treasures this universe conceals are just beginning, are you willing to just give up?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint, to gain the support of the six Chaos Great Saints, did not hesitate to disclose what he knew.

"An unrivaled Great Saint close to invincible?"

Tian Lu Great Saint’s pupils slightly contracted, knowing the significance of an invincible Great Saint; the boundless Chaos Void allows only one invincible Great Saint per era, and most eras have none.

To convince such an unrivaled Great Saint requires absolute superiority in strength, making other unrivaled Great Saints feel hopeless and unconquerable, creating a universally acknowledged invincible Great Saint.
